content: Aveiyag wawun kukwammeiliws o kuvvatays simsimiyas wasigeis? Adok peinan amisinap yagan kaya̱pam, to ivag ninoumiy babaw.
Tamtimwamons yakamiy, kupwa̱kitsa nag; mapuna kuweiys gamag. Kunineivs, ta-ma̱wan bukuba̱nes, mapuna kukwammeiliws o kuvvatays. Bo igak! Nag kunitougs waseg Yowbad; mapuna nag bukuba̱nes.
Kukin bukunitougs, nag kuba̱nes, peinan mikanitoug kalbaleb. Mikanitoug kalbaleb peinan amisinap kaya̱pam.
Takalbalebs yakamiy, adok kupiyaves datoveks Yowbad. Peinan kukwawes sinapun ven watinow, adok kupiyaves sinapun Yowbad. Kukin beivag sivinamiy ven watinow sinapun mo bukwamliwes Yowbad.
Awoum kudokes makava livan towen kweiboug nilel mamagina,

content.text: “Kululuwan, waseg towen Yowbad isen wanuwads singay ikalpwa̱kit wasigeis ya̱kids.”

content: Tage Yowbad singay ilabeids. Kweitan livan nises Bukitab waseg mamagina,

content.text: tage tasiyas tamma̱nums Yowbad bisiwyoubus kid.”

content: Kadiloka kutams Yowbad nakaleiwag waseg. E, kadiloka kupiyaves Seitan, mo bisawl.
Takalbalebs yakamiy, kusineikimas Yowbad waseg, Yowbad mo biwekeimiy yakamiy. Kuwidis amisinap kalbaleb; beivag ninoumiy katanok, sinap kamnat silma̱nin.
Kadiloka bigeg ninoumiy, peinan amisinap kalbaleb. Kuvva̱lams avakaein. Awoum kumwa̱saws o kugagigs, awoum. Bweina kuma̱nums wamatan Yowbad, igaw mo bilabeimiy, biyamweneimiy.

Sigwey, awoum kuvtokays livan simsimiyas wasigeis; awoum. Kal yak bukuvtok livan soum, o bukuyeg soum, mamagina kuyeg Yowbad nakaleiwag. Awoum. Kukin bukuyeg Yowbad nakaleiwag adok bo kupiyev kaleiwag towen, o bo bukumlavag takaleiwag teitan ya̱koum. Awoum.
Takaleiwag anmwa̱net-wan. Mtowen kadilok bikatinabweids o biyagageids. Makava gamag ya̱koum, awoum kuvtok livan soum.
Kunages agulivan guyawaw yakamiy. Awoum kulivans, “Nagein o nubweig bakaywout bakan palatan, bakasesun katanoka bweilim, bakakow mavavag singay babaw, bakamey.” Awoum.
Peinan nag kukwakins aveiyag bukulivatus nubweig, o asina̱vin bukukwanigs. Mwamovads gog mamagina wob, bisesun tut nag biveiyov, mo beikous.
Kadiloka bukulivans, “Magat daGuyaws nanon ma̱wan, bakasesuna mo bakawtel mawotet ma̱wan ma̱wan.”
Nagein gog kukwaypamwes amisinap, mamagina taga̱gas yakamiy. Sinap towen kalbaleb.
Kukin kal bikakin aw-wotet bwein tage bipiyev wotet towen, towen gog ansinap kalbaleb.
